clips.title: The story
paras: Northridge Lumber Camp is an active lumber mill nestled in the northern hills of the Western Plaguelands near Hearthglen. Currently held and fortified by the Scarlet Crusade, it provides timber vital to sustaining their nearby strongholds. Both the Alliance and the Horde view the facility as a prime target to cripple the zealots' regional infrastructure.

Situated just down the road from Hearthglen, the Northridge Lumber Camp serves as a vital logistics node for the Scarlet Crusade. Despite the lingering plague choking the surrounding forests, the camp fells and processes regional timber to construct fortifications, repair watchtowers, and furnish the crusade's war effort in Lordaeron. Heavily garrisoned by fanatical laborers and guards, the mill is fiercely protected against both the Scourge and outside trespassers.

Because Hearthglen depends heavily on this lumber to maintain its defenses, outside forces actively conspire to disrupt it. Both Alliance commanders and Horde scouts recognize that an overt assault on fortified crusader positions carries high costs. Instead, agents look to unconventional sabotage—such as unleashing voracious wood-boring termites into the mill's lumber stores—to quietly rot the Crusade's supplies from the inside out.
